say:10:1321805010:1.text: Before you stands a dead man who seeks eternal death rather than meaningless immortality. I'd be grateful if you could fulfill your duty here.
say:10:1321805010:1.source_cn: 在你的面前，就有一位视永生为虚无，而在追求永恒死亡的亡...

say:12:1321805012:2.text: Yes, you understood correctly. Please end me, the Graveborn in front of you.
say:12:1321805012:2.source_cn: 就是你想的那样，终结你眼前的亡灵——也就是我——的生命。

say:13:1321805013:1.text: But why? I'm afraid I can't oblige without knowing the reason.
say:13:1321805013:1.source_cn: 我不明白，您为何会有这样的请求？恕我不能答应。

say:14:1321805014:1.text: I imagine this must sound absurd to you.

say:15:1321805015:1.text: I only wish to understand your decision.
say:15:1321805015:1.source_cn: 我只是想尝试理解您的想法。

say:16:1321805016:1.text: My reasons are of little consequence. To you, I may be a friend of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s or the owner of this manor.
say:16:1321805016:1.source_cn: 我的想法并不重要，法拉莫尔先生，我只是希望你能尽到亡灵...
say:16:1321805016:1.male: My reasons are of little consequence. To you, I may be a friend of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s or the owner of this manor.
say:16:1321805016:1.female: My reasons are of little consequence. To you, I may be a friend of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s or the owner of this manor.

say:17:1321805017:1.text: But I must shatter that illusion. What you see before you is merely an empty husk, one that has endured the slow decay of time, spiraling into madness and despair. As I have said before, immortality is nothing but a curse.
say:17:1321805017:1.source_cn: 不……在你眼前的不过是一具空虚的躯体。太久的岁月会让人...

say:18:1321805018:1.text: Being an undead hunter does not mean I slay every Graveborn I encounter without reason. Someone as composed and well-mannered as yourself is not my enemy.
say:18:1321805018:1.source_cn: 虽然我是亡灵猎人，但我并不会毫无理由地猎杀每一位亡灵。...

say:19:1321805019:1.text: This manor, and you along with it, are still part of nature's cycle. So long as you possess the will to seek it, a new purpose may yet find you.
say:19:1321805019:1.source_cn: 这座庄园也好，您也好，只要您愿意，仍然可以遵循着自然循...

say:20:1321805020:1.text: Where death exists, so too does rebirth. Even when one purpose fades, time will offer another.
say:20:1321805020:1.source_cn: 死亡后总会迎来新生——在一个存在的意义消失后，时间会赋...

say:21:1321805021:1.text: Life holds meaning precisely because it is finite. When death becomes a luxury and eternity stretches endlessly before us, does that not strip life of its very essence?
say:21:1321805021:1.source_cn: 生命的意义只存在于可以计算的时日之内，一旦生命变为永恒...

say:22:1321805022:1.text: Yet, even in the harshest conditions, life persists. Trees take root in barren stone, and flowers bloom beneath the scorching sun and howling winds. Life will always find a way.
say:22:1321805022:1.source_cn: 野树会生在无土的石缝之中，荒漠里能找到坚韧地迎着烈日和...

say:23:1321805023:1.text: In my homeland, life is sacred for its purity and eternal through its cycle. That's the will of nature.
say:23:1321805023:1.source_cn: 在我的家乡，生命因纯粹而至高，因循环而永恒。这就是自然...

choice_prompt:24:1321805023.text: In my homeland, life is sacred for its purity and eternal through its cycle. That's the will of nature.
choice_prompt:24:1321805023.source_cn: 在我的家乡，生命因纯粹而至高，因循环而永恒。这就是自然的意志。

say:25:1321805024:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm glad you share my perspective on life. I believe you'll find a new purpose one day, Lord Ludovic.
say:25:1321805024:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm glad you share my perspective on life. I believe you'll find a new purpose one day, Lord Ludovic.
say:25:1321805024:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm glad you share my perspective on life. I believe you'll find a new purpose one day, Lord Ludovic.

say:26:1321805028:1.text: Mr. Faramor, are you certain you will not reconsider my request? I would have thought your duty was to fight a Graveborn, not engage in idle debate with one.
say:26:1321805028:1.source_cn: 亡灵猎人先生，你真的不再考虑一下我的请求吗？我想，你的...

say:27:1321805029:1.text: Or perhaps... you have only ever vanquished the Graveborn with words? If that is the case, I fear you are ill-suited for your profession.
say:27:1321805029:1.source_cn: 又或者说……你只会依靠辩论来战胜亡灵？这样看来，你所谓...

say:28:1321805030:1.text: Lord Ludovic, do you truly believe your life has lost all meaning?
say:28:1321805030:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔先生，你真的认为活着已经没有任何意义了吗？

say:31:1321805033:1.text: If that is your stance, then I apologize for troubling you.
say:31:1321805033:1.source_cn: 既然如此……很抱歉打扰您了，柳博米尔先生。

say:34:1321805035:1.text: No matter the circumstances, I cannot grant Lord Ludovic's request... It is unfortunate that our meeting ended on such terms.
say:34:1321805035:1.source_cn: 无论如何，我都无法答应这位柳博米尔先生的要求……看来这...

say:35:1321805036:1.text: Mr. Faramor, where are you heading next?
say:35:1321805036:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，接下来你打算去哪里？

say:36:1321805037:1.text: I gave Carolina my word—I'll be patrolling the area to watch for any rogue undead. Care to join me?
say:36:1321805037:1.source_cn: 既然已经答应了卡列琳娜女士，我准备去周边地区巡视一圈，...

say:37:1321805038:1.text: You bet! Sir Chippy would never pass up a chance to help the people!
say:37:1321805038:1.source_cn: 当然！这种事情怎么能少得了正义的骑士满满呢？！

choice:30:0:1.text: Um, should we call it a day?
choice:30:0:1.male: Um, should we call it a day?
choice:30:0:1.female: Um, should we call it a day?

say:40:1321805032:1.source_cn: 总觉得不能让两位先生继续辩论下去了……

choice:30:1:2.text: This is getting out of hand.
choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 这场会面发展到了我不理解的阶段
choice:30:1:2.male: This is getting out of hand.
choice:30:1:2.female: This is getting out of hand.

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 我赞同法拉莫尔的说法

say:42:1321805025:1.text: It's uncanny how well you understand me. Doesn't Mr. Faramor seem more like a preacher than an undead hunter? How amusing.
say:42:1321805025:1.source_cn: 的确，你一向能理解我。真有趣，比起亡灵猎人，这位法拉莫...
say:42:1321805025:1.male: It's uncanny how well you understand me. Doesn't Mr. Faramor seem more like a preacher than an undead hunter? How amusing.
say:42:1321805025:1.female: It's uncanny how well you understand me. Doesn't Mr. Faramor seem more like a preacher than an undead hunter? How amusing.

choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 我觉得柳博米尔有道理

say:43:1321805026:1.text: Ah, simply a discussion on the nature of life, nothing more.
say:43:1321805026:1.source_cn: 只是一些关于生命的讨论而已。
say:43:1321805026:1.male: Ah, simply a discussion on the nature of life, nothing more.
say:43:1321805026:1.female: Ah, simply a discussion on the nature of life, nothing more.

choice:24:2:3.source_cn: 太深奥了，你们到底在说什么……

say:45:1321805003:1.text: Huh, I must have come off as harsh often for you to doubt that... To be more precise, I'm curious, as you have an undead hunter with you.
say:45:1321805003:1.source_cn: 看来我得怀疑过去我讲话是否过于刻薄了……其实我只是很好...
say:45:1321805003:1.male: Huh, I must have come off as harsh often for you to doubt that... To be more precise, I'm curious, as you have an undead hunter with you.
say:45:1321805003:1.female: Huh, I must have come off as harsh often for you to doubt that... To be more precise, I'm curious, as you have an undead hunter with you.

choice:2:1:2.text: Is that a compliment or what?
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你的“有趣”应该是正面的意思吧
choice:2:1:2.male: Is that a compliment or what?
choice:2:1:2.female: Is that a compliment or what?

say:0:1321806001:0.source_cn: 走吧， 我们去巡视一番。

say:0:1321807001:0.text: There's no sign of the undead here—this area is relatively safe.
say:0:1321807001:0.source_cn: 这里没有活死人的气息，相对安全。

say:0:1321808001:0.text: I can smell human blood in the distance... Something's amiss. Follow me!
say:0:1321808001:0.source_cn: 远处有人类血液的味道……一定出事了，跟我来！

say:0:1321809001:0.text: This place is teeming with undead... Ah, someone has collapsed!
say:0:1321809001:0.source_cn: 好多活死人，啊……有个人倒在地上！

say:1:1321809002:0.text: Let's deal with these undead first!

say:1:1321810001:3.text: Hey! Hey! Can you hear me?

say:2:1321810002:1.text: He's lost too much blood. We need to stop the bleeding first.
say:2:1321810002:1.source_cn: 这位先生失血过多昏过去了，我们得先为他止血。

say:3:1321810003:1.text: Chippy, apply pressure to his wounds.
say:3:1321810003:1.source_cn: 满满先生，我需要你帮我按住他的伤口。

say:6:1321810005:1.text: The bleeding won't stop... There must be another way.
say:6:1321810005:1.source_cn: 血还是止不住，这样不是办法……

say:7:1321810006:1.text: I picked up some herbs from Cedartown, but I haven't had a chance to brew the potion yet...
say:7:1321810006:1.source_cn: 我刚从雪松镇采购了一些药草，还没来得及加工一下，情况紧急……

say:8:1321810007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm counting on you to prepare the healing potion while I treat his wounds.
say:8:1321810007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm counting on you to prepare the healing potion while I treat his wounds.
say:8:1321810007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm counting on you to prepare the healing potion while I treat his wounds.

say:7:1321811001:3.text: Chippy, you can let go now. We need to treat the wounds.
say:7:1321811001:3.source_cn: 满满先生，松开捂住伤口的手，我们得给他的伤口处理一下。

narration:9:1321811003:0.text: The bleeding won't stop even after Faramor applies the potion to the relatively shallow wounds. The man is fading fast.
narration:9:1321811003:0.source_cn: 法拉莫尔将药剂涂抹在男子的伤口上，但不知为何，这几道不...

say:14:1321811006:1.text: What did you say? Hey, wake up! Don't fall asleep!
say:14:1321811006:1.source_cn: 你说什么？喂，你醒醒啊，不要睡！

say:15:1321811007:1.text: Magister... He's gone... I hate the undead!
say:15:1321811007:1.source_cn: 主人……他……他死了。这些可恶的活死人！
say:15:1321811007:1.male: Magister... He's gone... I hate the undead!
say:15:1321811007:1.female: Magister... He's gone... I hate the undead!

say:16:1321811008:1.text: But his wounds aren't even that serious. Since we applied the potion immediately, he should have been fine.
say:16:1321811008:1.source_cn: 奇怪，伤口并没有那么复杂，我们也第一时间炼制了药剂，不...

say:17:1321811009:1.text: They weren't bite wounds, nor the deep slashes or strangulation marks typical of the undead. Yet... they hindered his body's ability to clot the blood.
say:17:1321811009:1.source_cn: 这些伤口不是咬痕，比常见的活死人抓痕或者扼痕也更浅一些...

say:18:1321811010:1.text: Maybe those undead were infected with some kind of mutated virus...
say:18:1321811010:1.source_cn: 或许那几个活死人感染了什么变异病毒……

say:19:1321811011:1.text: Regardless, we must lay this poor man to rest.
say:19:1321811011:1.source_cn: 无论如何，我们得将这位先生安顿一下。

say:1:1321812001:1.text: Poor guy... He came here to bury his wife.
say:1:1321812001:1.source_cn: 可怜的人……他是为了自己的妻子来到这里的。

say:3:1321812002:0.text: I suppose this beautiful box holds his wife's remains...
say:3:1321812002:0.source_cn: 这个精致的盒子里一定是他妻子的遗骨……

say:5:1321812003:0.text: He mentioned his daughter in this letter—she's likely still in Cedartown.
say:5:1321812003:0.source_cn: 信件上提到了他们的女儿，应该还在雪松镇。

say:6:1321812004:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we... tell the girl about her father?
say:6:1321812004:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we... tell the girl about her father?
say:6:1321812004:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we... tell the girl about her father?

choice_prompt:7:1321812004.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we... tell the girl about her father?
choice_prompt:7:1321812004.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，我们……要把这个消息带给那个叫奥尔嘉的孩子吗？
choice_prompt:7:1321812004.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we... tell the girl about her father?
choice_prompt:7:1321812004.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we... tell the girl about her father?

say:8:1321812005:1.text: I'm not sure how she'll take it... but we must see her.
say:8:1321812005:1.source_cn: 对于孩子来说，是不是有些太沉重了呢……

say:9:1321812006:1.source_cn: 我来为这位先生做遗体净化。

narration:10:1321812007:1.text: After Faramor purifies the man's body, you place his remains together with his wife's.

say:3:1321813003:1.text: Wait, that box holds my Mama's remains! Why do you have it? Where's my Papa?
say:3:1321813003:1.source_cn: 啊，那个……那是我妈妈的遗骨！为什么会在你们手里，我爸爸呢？

say:4:1321813004:1.text: We ran into your father... He...
say:4:1321813004:1.source_cn: 我们在路上遇到了你父亲……他……

choice_prompt:5:1321813004.text: We ran into your father... He...
choice_prompt:5:1321813004.source_cn: 我们在路上遇到了你父亲……他……

say:6:1321813005:1.text: Some undead attacked him... We did everything we could, but we couldn't save him...
say:6:1321813005:1.source_cn: 活死人袭击了他……对不起，我们努力了，但是没能救回他……

say:7:1321813008:1.text: No... that's impossible! *Sob* Don't lie to me! Tell me where Papa is! I'll go to him! I'll go to him right now!
say:7:1321813008:1.source_cn: ……不可能的，爸爸才不会死！呜呜……你不要骗我……你告...
say:7:1321813008:1.male: No... that's impossible! *Sob* Don't lie to me! Tell me where Papa is! I'll go to him! I'll go to him right now!
say:7:1321813008:1.female: No... that's impossible! *Sob* Don't lie to me! Tell me where Papa is! I'll go to him! I'll go to him right now!

say:8:1321813009:2.text: This can't be true! Papa promised me... he'd stay with me and watch me grow up...
say:8:1321813009:2.source_cn: 呜呜呜……不会的，爸爸答应过我，他说我没有妈妈了……他...

say:9:1321813010:1.text: Papa never breaks his promises... *Sob* You must be making this up...
say:9:1321813010:1.source_cn: 我爸爸从来不会说话不算话……呜呜……你们骗人……

say:10:1321813011:1.text: Papa... Why are you doing this to me...
say:10:1321813011:1.source_cn: 爸爸……为什么你也要骗我……呜呜……

say:12:1321813013:1.text: Your father's remains are in this box as well. We'll help you lay them to rest—together. I swear it. They will find peace in the divine realm for all the good they've done.
say:12:1321813013:1.source_cn: 我们将他的遗骨和你妈妈的遗骨安置在了一起……我会陪你一...

say:13:1321813014:1.text: But... I want them here with me...
say:13:1321813014:1.source_cn: 呜呜……可我、我不想他们去陪神明，我想他们陪着我……

say:14:1321813015:1.text:
...I know. No one can take their place, but if you ever need someone by your side, I'll be here._x000D_
My name is Faramor.
say:14:1321813015:1.source_cn: 对不起……我知道我们都无法代替你的父母，但如果你需要陪...

narration:16:1321813017:4.text: Orla's cries stir sympathy among the nearby townsfolk, and the news of her father's death quickly sparks their anger.

say:18:1321813018:1.text: What? Those undead are at it again? Oh, poor child...
say:18:1321813018:1.source_cn: 什么！活死人又袭击人了！唉，可怜的孩子……

say:20:1321813019:1.text: They claim they once protected Whiteridge? Enough of this nonsense! They've killed so many of us! The acolytes should have burned them all!
say:20:1321813019:1.source_cn: ……还说什么它们过去都是保护白山的战士，但现在有很多都...

say:22:1321813020:1.text: I heard there aren't enough acolytes to keep watch over them, so those that used to roam the lake are now loose!
say:22:1321813020:1.source_cn: 听说修道院的人手不够，看不住它们，那些原本在湖区游荡的...

say:23:1321813021:1.text: We have to stop them! Mr. Faramor, you can get rid of these undead, can't you? We're willing to pay you for your service!
say:23:1321813021:1.source_cn: 不行……不能让活死人这样伤人了，法拉莫尔先生，您一定能...

say:24:1321813022:1.text: Yes, I can chip in too! You've got to help us out!
say:24:1321813022:1.source_cn: 对对对，我也可以出钱！您可一定要把那些活死人都干掉！

say:26:1321813023:1.text: Everyone, remain calm. I'll patrol the area and ensure this does not happen again.
say:26:1321813023:1.source_cn: 诸位，请别急，我会巡视周边，尽量不让活死人伤人的事情再发生。

say:27:1321813024:1.text: We're counting on you then! It's best we all stay indoors for now to avoid those nasty creatures. Tsk...
say:27:1321813024:1.source_cn: 那就拜托你了！这阵子我们还是少出门，这群脏东西又回来了，啧。

say:29:1321813006:2.text: You're lying! Papa would never leave me alone and hand the box to someone else! He promised he'd bury Mama himself.
say:29:1321813006:2.source_cn: 你……你骗人。爸爸才不会离开我，他也不会将妈妈的遗骨交...
say:29:1321813006:2.male: You're lying! Papa would never leave me alone and hand the box to someone else! He promised he'd bury Mama himself.
say:29:1321813006:2.female: You're lying! Papa would never leave me alone and hand the box to someone else! He promised he'd bury Mama himself.

say:30:1321813007:1.text: I... I'm a big girl now. Please, tell me the truth—what happened to Papa?
say:30:1321813007:1.source_cn: 我……我不是小孩子了，求求你，告诉我吧，我爸爸到底怎么了？
say:30:1321813007:1.male: I... I'm a big girl now. Please, tell me the truth—what happened to Papa?
say:30:1321813007:1.female: I... I'm a big girl now. Please, tell me the truth—what happened to Papa?

choice_prompt:31:1321813007.text: I... I'm a big girl now. Please, tell me the truth—what happened to Papa?
choice_prompt:31:1321813007.source_cn: 我……我不是小孩子了，求求你，告诉我吧，我爸爸到底怎么了？
choice_prompt:31:1321813007.male: I... I'm a big girl now. Please, tell me the truth—what happened to Papa?
choice_prompt:31:1321813007.female: I... I'm a big girl now. Please, tell me the truth—what happened to Papa?

choice:31:0:1.text: He was killed by the undead...
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 他被活死人袭击，去世了……
choice:31:0:1.male: He was killed by the undead...
choice:31:0:1.female: He was killed by the undead...

choice:5:1:2.text: He asked us to check on you.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 他临时有事，让我们照顾你
choice:5:1:2.male: He asked us to check on you.
choice:5:1:2.female: He asked us to check on you.

say:1:1321814001:1.text: Orla, could you stay in town for a while?
say:1:1321814001:1.source_cn: 奥尔嘉，你先在镇子里待一阵好吗？

say:2:1321814002:2.text: Faramor, a-are you leaving me too?
say:2:1321814002:2.source_cn: 呜呜……法拉莫尔，你……你要走了吗？

say:3:1321814003:1.text: I knew it... Adults never keep their promises! *Sob* You're just like Mama and Papa...
